name: tieline
description: Local-first user-story mapping CLI and MCP server for connecting product context, lifecycle history, code, and knowledge-base articles.

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run clean && npm run build
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && npm run typecheck:ui && npm run typecheck:scripts
scripts.test:tieline: npm run build && npm run test:tieline:built
scripts.test:offline: npm run build && npm run test:offline:built
scripts.test:offline:built: npm run test:integration-safety && npm run test:tieline:built && npm run test:ranking && npm run test:retrieval && npm run test:embeddings && npm run test:http && npm run test:smoke
scripts.test:offline:fast: npm run test:integration-safety && npm run test:ranking && npm run test:retrieval && npm run test:embeddings && npm run test:http && npm run test:smoke
scripts.check:fast: npm run typecheck && npm run test:offline:fast && npm run test:guardrails
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run typecheck:ui && npm run typecheck:scripts && npm run test:offline:built && npm run test:guardrails && npm pack --dry-run --ignore-scripts
